agenda_text:
BELMONT SHORE PARKING AND BUSINESS
  IMPROVEMENT AREA ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JULY 18, 2024
  5365 2ND STREET
  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

Matthew Peterson, Chair  Jodi Meade, Commissioner
Jann Kronick-Gath, Vice Chair  Aaron Tofani, Commissioner

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54160  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Belmont Shore Parking and
  Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission meeting of Thursday, May 16,
  2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54161  Recommendation to receive and file a financial report for the period ending June
  30, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-54162  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Transit Employee Bus Pass
  Program Status for May and June 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-54163  Recommendation to hold elections to appoint a new Commission Vice-Chair.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-54176  Recommendation to approve the Conservation Corps of Long Beach Scope of
  Work from July 1, 2024 to December 31, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-54177  Recommendation to approve quote for an arborist to inspect trees and site
  conditions in the Belmont Shore Business District.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

7.  24-54178  Recommendation to recommend to City Council to increase the parking meter rate
  to $2.00 per hour, at a 2-hour maximum.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  24-54179  Recommendation to approve and receive updates on the Belmont Shore gateway
  signage replacement project.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory
Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments
unless extended by the Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Teri A. Luce, Asst Admin Analyst, Public Works certify that the agenda was posted not less than
72 hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact TeriA.Luce@LongBeach.gov.
